blog.title: Upgrading my AI agent to x402 - getting more open and private
blog.description: I replaced my AI assistant's custodial smart contract with x402 payment channels — so I no longer hold anyone's money, nothing is published per message, and any client can find and pay the agent.

On the left, a complex diagram with a user, an AI assistant, a custom upgradeable smart contract, and many blockchain settlement arrows representing custody and public message traces. nftMetadata.description: AI generated artwork based on the prompt: "Cinematic illustration in the visual style of Breaking Bad. Saul Goodman sits confidently at a large desk in the center of a dark abstract space, wearing his colorful suit, acting as an institutional mediator rather than a lawyer. On the left and right, Walter White and Jesse Pinkman sit isolated in separate interrogation rooms, unable to communicate. Between Saul and each prisoner float stacks of legal documents connected by glowing lines. Some documents are flipped over, symbolizing strategic choices. Above the scene hover elegant mathematical expressions from game theory mixed with quantum circuit symbols, quantum gates, entanglement notation, and abstract logic diagrams. Thin glowing quantum connections subtly link the two stacks of documents through Saul's desk. The overall composition feels like economics meets quantum physics rather than science fiction. Dramatic cinematic lighting, realistic, highly detailed, muted colors with yellow-green Breaking Bad atmosphere."

nftMetadata.description:
AI generated artwork based on the prompt: "A beautiful aerial view of a rugged Brittany coastline in France, designed as a visual introduction to the idea of coastline complexity for a curious 10–12 year old. The coastline is the main subject: large bays contain smaller coves, rocky inlets, little peninsulas and scattered offshore rocks, creating a clear sense that the coast becomes more intricate the closer you look. Camera looking diagonally down from high above, enough elevation to see the overall shape but close enough to appreciate many small irregularities along the shoreline. Natural Atlantic landscape, exposed granite rocks, muted sea, grassy coastal cliffs, overcast soft Breton light.

Clean, quiet, intellectually curious visual style, realistic but slightly illustrated, no people, no buildings, no boats, no text, no mathematical symbols, no grid. The image should feel like looking at a real place and suddenly realizing how extraordinarily complicated its coastline is. Minimal composition, generous visual space, subtle colors, suitable as the hero image for a thoughtful science article for children."
